name: Jardinópolis (Santa Catarina, Brazil)
description: Divided on a rising diagonal into a purple-blue upper fly and a green lower hoist by a broad yellow band bordered in white, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the municipal arms.
history: Jardinópolis is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag uses four colours of the national flag: blue on the upper triangle for the sky, green on the lower triangle for reforestation, agriculture and conservation, and yellow and white for the diagonal band.

features.role: blue upper fly and green lower hoist
municipal arms with a mural crown, maize and a landscape, reading JARDINÓPOLIS-SC
